problem: `.nv-hero--compact .nv-hero__media` (specificity 0,0,2,0) is declared at line 676, above the breakpoints, so it beats the `.nv-hero__media` rules (specificity 0,0,1,0) inside `@media (max-width:900px)` (line 1336, `3 / 2`) and `@media (max-width:560px)` (line 1374, `4 / 5`). nosotros.html, procesos.html, en/about.html and en/processes.html therefore keep a 21:7 letterbox hero on phones: at 375 px wide the media box is 125 px tall, while `.nv-hero__inner` is `position:absolute; inset:0` inside a box with `overflow:hidden` — the eyebrow, the `clamp(40px,6vw,76px)` h1 and the standfirst are clipped away. The author already solved exactly this problem for the contact hero in §27 (lines 1516 and 1521 restate 3:2 and 4:5 for `.nv-hero--16x9`) but never did it for `--compact`.
evidence: line 676: `.nv-hero--compact .nv-hero__media { aspect-ratio: 21 / 7; }` — with no counterpart inside the 900 px / 560 px blocks.
fix: Mirror the §27 pattern: add `.nv-hero--compact .nv-hero__media { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }` inside `@media (max-width:900px)` and `.nv-hero--compact .nv-hero__media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }` inside `@media (max-width:560px)`. Better still, drive the ratio from a custom property (`.nv-hero__media { aspect-ratio: var(--hero-ratio, 21/9) }`, `.nv-hero--compact { --hero-ratio: 21/7 }`) so the breakpoints only ever reset the property and the specificity trap cannot recur.

problem: Every micro-label set on paper uses `--text-muted` (= `--nv-ink-300` #8A8272) on `--surface-page` #F6F3EC. Measured contrast is 3.44:1, below the 4.5:1 AA floor for normal-size text — and these are 10–11 px letterspaced uppercase, the hardest text on the page to read. This is not one component: it is the section rule labels, figure captions, card meta, spec labels, key-figure labels, the lightbox index and the hero plinth label, i.e. the site's entire wayfinding layer, on all ten pages. Contract §6 sets contrast as part of the accessibility floor.
evidence: line 206 `.nv-label { … color: var(--text-muted); }`, line 704 `.nv-rule__label { … color: var(--text-muted); }`, line 712 `.nv-rule__index`, line 827 `.nv-card__meta`, line 872 `.nv-figure__caption`, line 901 `.nv-figures__label`, line 937 `.nv-spec__label`, line 1267 `.nv-lightbox__index`, line 1198 `.nv-video__caption`.
fix: Switch the paper-side micro-label colour to `--text-secondary` (`--nv-ink-700` #2A2723 → 13.4:1). The ink-theme override already remaps `--text-secondary` to `rgba(246,243,236,.76)` (9.8:1 on ink), so the ink bands and the footer stay correct with no extra rules. Keep `--text-muted` only for the footer bottom row, where it resolves to `rgba(246,243,236,.5)` on ink and passes at 4.65:1.

problem: `.nv-hero--compact .nv-hero__media` (specificity 0,2,0) is declared at line 676 and is never restated inside the responsive blocks, so it beats the lower-specificity `.nv-hero__media` rules in the media queries at lines 1336 (`3 / 2`) and 1374 (`4 / 5`) regardless of source order. The compact hero therefore keeps a 21:7 box at every viewport. At a 360 px viewport the media box is 360 × 7/21 = 120 px tall, while `.nv-hero__inner` (absolutely positioned, `inset: 0`, 48 px padding-block top and bottom plus eyebrow + h1 at 40 px + standfirst) needs roughly 330–390 px. `.nv-hero__media` has `overflow: hidden`, so the h1 and the standfirst are cut off top and bottom on every phone. Affects nosotros.html, procesos.html, en/about.html, en/processes.html — on procesos/en-processes the two hero buttons vanish entirely. The author already handled exactly this trap for the contact hero (`.nv-hero--16x9` is restated at lines 1516 and 1521 with the comment "the responsive steps below restate 3:2 and 4:5 for the same reason") and simply missed the compact variant.
evidence: line 676: `.nv-hero--compact .nv-hero__media { aspect-ratio: 21 / 7; }`  — no counterpart inside `@media (max-width: 900px)` or `@media (max-width: 560px)`, unlike lines 1516/1521 for `.nv-hero--16x9`.
fix: Add the two restatements next to the existing 16x9 ones: inside `@media (max-width: 900px)` add `.nv-hero--compact .nv-hero__media { aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; }` and inside `@media (max-width: 560px)` add `.nv-hero--compact .nv-hero__media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }`.

problem: The hero content box is fixed by `aspect-ratio` and the content is absolutely positioned inside it with no escape valve, so the home-page hero copy is clipped on phones. At a 360 px viewport, `.nv-hero__media` is 4/5 → 450 px tall (line 1374; `max-height` at line 1372 can only shrink it, never grow it). The content inside `.nv-hero__inner` at that width is: 96 px padding-block (2 × `--space-7`, line 620, not reduced by the breakpoints), 14 px eyebrow, ~3 lines of h1 at 40 px / 0.98 ≈ 118 px, ~6 lines of standfirst at 18 px / 1.7 ≈ 184 px, 3 × 16 px gaps = 48 px, and the two hero buttons which at 312 px of available inline space cannot sit on one row (`Productos` ≈ 136 px + `Video corporativo` ≈ 203 px + 12 px gap > 312 px) so they take 2 × 44 px + 12 px + 8 px = 108 px. Total ≈ 568 px against 450 px available; even under maximally generous line-count assumptions the floor is ~441 px, i.e. zero margin. Because `.nv-hero__inner` is `justify-content: center` inside a box with `overflow: hidden`, the eyebrow is clipped at the top and the call-to-action buttons at the bottom. Affects index.html and en/index.html (longest title + longest standfirst + two buttons).
evidence: line 589 `aspect-ratio: 21 / 9;` + line 1374 `.nv-hero__media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }` + line 612–620 `.nv-hero__inner { position: absolute; inset: 0; … justify-content: center; padding-block: var(--space-7); }` with `.nv-hero__media { overflow: hidden }` (line 591).
fix: Stop pinning the content: in `@media (max-width: 900px)` change `.nv-hero__media` from a hard ratio to `aspect-ratio: auto; min-height: 62svh` (or keep the ratio but add `min-height: max-content`) and make `.nv-hero__inner` static (`position: static`) with the image absolutely positioned behind it, so the box grows to fit the copy. Also reduce `.nv-hero__inner { padding-block: var(--space-5); }` below 560 px.

problem: Every micro-label, caption, spec label, rule label and card meta line on the paper ground is painted in `--text-muted` (`--nv-ink-300` = #8A8272) at 10–11 px. Against `--surface-page` (#F6F3EC) that measures 3.44:1 (relative luminances 0.2258 and 0.8975). WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 requires 4.5:1 for text this size — 10–11 px is nowhere near the "large text" threshold of 24 px. This is site-wide: it hits `.nv-label` (line 205), `.nv-lang__link` (376), `.nv-rule__label` (704), `.nv-rule__index` (712), `.nv-card__meta` (827), `.nv-figure__caption` (872), `.nv-figures__label` (901), `.nv-spec__label` (937) and `.nv-video__caption` (1198) on all ten pages. The same token inside `data-nv-theme="ink"` resolves to rgba(246,243,236,.5) on #0B0B0B ≈ 4.9:1 and does pass, so only the paper side is failing.
evidence: `.nv-label { … color: var(--text-muted); }` (site.css line 199–206) rendering #8A8272 on #F6F3EC = 3.44:1 at `--fs-label` 10px.
fix: Do not edit the read-only tokens. In site.css swap `var(--text-muted)` for `var(--text-secondary)` (#2A2723 → 13.4:1 on paper) on the paper-side small-text selectors listed above, or define one local token `--site-label-fg: var(--text-secondary)` in §01 and use it for all micro-labels, leaving the ink-scope rules alone.

problem: Several interactive targets fall well below the contract's 44 px floor (§6), and two of them are touch-only controls. `.nv-lang__link` is a bare inline 11 px text link with no padding and no min-height; it stays visible below 900 px (the 900 px block hides `.nv-nav` and `.nv-header__cta` but not `.nv-lang`), so on a phone the only language switch in the header is roughly 22 × 22 px. `.nv-drawer__foot a` is 13 px text at line-height 1.7 ≈ 22 px tall with 12 px gaps — those are the phone numbers, the e-mail and the second language switch inside the mobile drawer. `.nv-footer__link` is 13 px in `li` at line-height 1.5 ≈ 20 px with 8 px gaps. `.nv-link-arrow` (index.html/en/index.html, "Nuestros Procesos") is ~19 px tall. The author fixed exactly this problem for the processes stage index with `.nv-index-link { min-height: var(--control-h) }` (line 1541) but did not apply the same treatment elsewhere.
evidence: lines 372–378 `.nv-lang__link { color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; transition: var(--transition-ink); }` — no `min-height`, no padding; lines 497–503 `.nv-drawer__foot a { font-size: var(--fs-body-sm); … }`; lines 550–556 `.nv-footer__link { font-size: var(--fs-body-sm); … }`; lines 249–261 `.nv-link-arrow { … padding-block-end: var(--space-1); }`.
fix: Give each of them the same treatment as `.nv-index-link`: `display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--control-h);` on `.nv-lang__link`, `.nv-drawer__foot a`, `.nv-footer__link` and `.nv-link-arrow` (for `.nv-lang__link`, add `padding-inline: var(--space-2)` so the hit box is ≥44 px wide as well).

problem: The header "Contacto"/"Contact" button uses `.nv-btn--sm`, whose height is `--control-h-sm` = 32 px, below the contract's 44 px control floor. It is hidden below 900 px so this is pointer-only, but it is the one persistent call-to-action in the chrome on all ten pages.
evidence: `.nv-btn--sm { height: var(--control-h-sm); padding-inline: var(--control-px-sm); font-size: var(--fs-label); }` (site.css line 786) applied by `Contacto` (index.html line 58 and the equivalent line 40 on the other nine pages).
fix: Drop `nv-btn--sm` from the header CTA on all ten pages so it uses the standard `--control-h` (44 px), or add `.nv-header__cta { min-height: var(--control-h); }` to site.css.
